goal: Generate a warm Mid-Autumn festival children’s book page layout that can span across two pages or be formatted as a single page, with a clear sense of storytelling and festive symbols.

story.theme: The little fox whispering to the moon for the first time
story.scene: On the Mid-Autumn night in a Jiangnan town, tiled roofs and lotus lamps spread across the distant river below.
story.moment: A little fox catches a wisp of rising moonlight, feeling for the first time that the wind can smell as fragrant as osmanthus

main_character.description: A fluffy orange fox, wearing a dark blue drool bib, sitting on a round cloud that resembles a mooncake surface
main_character.expression: Eyes curved like a crescent moon, mouth slightly open as if in awe
main_character.pose: Front paw gently resting on the edge of the clouds, hind legs suspended in the air, slightly lifted by the wind

items: A couple of Kongming lanterns with simple drawings of little rabbits peeking out
A row of sleeping black-tiled cat silhouettes on the eaves in the distance.

style.art_style: Mixing dry and wet watercolor application, outlining with fine pencil lines.
style.color_palette: Persimmon red, moon white, indigo night sky, with dots of golden osmanthus.
style.rendering: Cold-pressed watercolor paper texture, edges intentionally left white to create a moonlight halo

text_overlay.text: He suddenly understood that the taste of reunion is the fragrance of wind and osmanthus.
text_overlay.position: Bottom edge of the screen centered, with a large night sky above

must_keep: The main character occupies the area of highest visual contrast.
Sentences are within 20 words and easy to read.
No horror, no dark fairy tales
avoid: Draw the moon as an anthropomorphic celestial body with facial features
Full page filled with river lanterns forming pattern noise
Overly strong cool tones dilute the festive warmth
